cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down; I'll pour the tea. You asked how lunch was: the soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cut you something else while we talk. The soup was a little salty, since you asked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop offering food. Tell me what happened to the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No food, then. On your earlier question, I wouldn't order the soup again.

reason: Make A take hosting control and offer replacement food, then respect B no-food boundary while still supplying the earlier lunch review.
